profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Visa
profile.summary: Graduated from WWU with a Bachelor in Computer Science. I am now working at Visa in Highlands Ranch, CO.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed WordPress sites. Dabbled in Laravel 5. Always keeping up to date with everything cutting edge in web development.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Working at Catch was a monumental opportunity for me. I learned an a lot in a small time period and was able to develop many useful skills while at Catch. For more information about Catch Design take a look at my portfolio and also their website (can be found in my portfolio).

positions.title: Student Assistant/Barista
positions.description: Maintaining a clean store environment for customers as well as employees. Run the cash register and converse with customers. Make & serve beverages. Make sure that the shop was stocked with all necessary products. Every few hours I was responsible for balancing the cash register and making a deposit.

positions.title: Shop Assistant
positions.description: General tasks like laundry, cleaning, and going to the bank. Greet customers and get them signed in, and ring them up on their way out.
